Some of what you selected may need prompt attention.

You can stop or continue later at any time.
Your Safety comes First.

screens.title: Ready to continue?
body: Atlas is organizing your responses by identifying observed experiences, looking for recurring patterns, and connecting experiences that may be related.
It will create a safe, non-diagnostic reflection that focuses on body literacy and keeps your own experience at the center.
This will build your first Atlas Record, a private starting point for noticing what remains stable, what changes, and what becomes clearer over time.
